CARE THAT MOVES WITH YOU

Shockwave Therapy

Explore whether shockwave fits your care.

Shockwave therapy uses a device to deliver sound waves through the skin to a selected area. It is an option used for some persistent tendon and related soft-tissue problems.

UNDERSTANDING YOUR OPTIONS

What is involved?

An assessment comes first. Your physiotherapist can explain why it may or may not suit your symptoms, what treatment feels like, and how it relates to your wider rehabilitation plan.

What to expect

Your appointment is a chance to ask questions, share your priorities, and understand the proposed approach.

  • An assessment before treatment is considered
  • Discussion of suitability and alternatives
  • An explanation of sensations, risks, and follow-up

Before your visit

Wear comfortable clothing and bring any relevant referral letters, scan reports, or instructions from another healthcare professional. Make a note of the questions you would like to ask.

Your questions, answered.

Is shockwave suitable for everyone?+

No. The clinician needs to review your symptoms and health history before recommending it. Ask about the expected benefits, limitations, and risks for your situation.

How many sessions will I need?+

The plan depends on your assessment, goals, and response. Discuss a review point with your physiotherapist rather than assuming a fixed number of visits.

How do I make an enquiry?+

The enquiry button opens our booking page with this treatment selected. Add your preferences and download your request. The clinic must confirm availability before an appointment is booked.
